title: Wordris
tagline: Letters tumble one at a time into a narrow well.
blurb: Letters tumble one at a time into a narrow well. Steer each one home and spell a three- or four-letter word across or down to score and clear it, with treble-letter, double-letter and double-word squares to aim for. A shadow shows where it will land, falling letters can spell a fresh word for a cascade, and every thirty letters the pace quickens.
controls: Restart (in pause or at game over)
